description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first edge runtime that fuses Express‑style simplicity, Fastify‑grade performance, and AI‑driven routing for Node, Bun, Deno & Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the surge in AI‑augmented edge computing by positioning yantravese as the *only* zero‑dependency runtime that combines TypeScript‑first ergonomics, built‑in LLM‑ready routing, and native support for HTTP/3, QUIC, and WebGPU. Highlight the cross‑platform reach (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers) and the ability to drop‑in replace Express/Fastify without rewriting code, while gaining AI‑powered request handling, ultra‑low latency, and full observability (OTel, telemetry). Emphasize the daily‑release cadence (v0.0.166‑daily) to convey active innovation and community responsiveness.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for instant AI‑driven routing that turns natural‑language intents into endpoint handlers—no extra libraries needed.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond request latency on Cloudflare Workers and Bun, thanks to a zero‑dependency core and native HTTP/3 support.
The TypeScript‑first API, built‑in OpenAPI/GraphQL generation, and out‑of‑the‑box OTEL telemetry give a frictionless developer experience from prototype to production.
